structured.answer: I'd open the account at פסגות and buy אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125 (5112628), the one the page marked "★ הזול". With the page's example of 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month, it says I'd end up with about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years. If פסגות feels weird, I'd go with לאומי, the second one at 82,968 ₪.

stuck.why: Never heard of פסגות. The big bank I trust, לאומי, was second, so I hesitated about which to pick.
